output.one_liner: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with real-time alerts and status pages for developers and DevOps teams.
output.description: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use, self-hosted monitoring tool that allows users to monitor the uptime of websites, servers, and services. It provides a responsive dashboard, status pages, and supports over 90 notification services including Telegram, Discord, and Slack. The app supports multiple monitoring types including HTTP(s), TCP, DNS, and Docker containers with 20-second intervals.

icp.who: Technical users managing personal or small business infrastructure
icp.pain: Need reliable, self-hosted monitoring without depending on third-party services
icp.buying_trigger: Migrating from a hosted uptime service or setting up a new self-hosted infrastructure

differentiators: Multiple status pages with custom domains
